description: Agent Operations: submit one job’s execution trace: its steps with their tool calls, recorded failures and recoveries, which steps are required and which replace others, and the final outcome as recorded. The signed brief classifies every failure as recovered (the job absorbed it), worked around (a different path finished the step) or fatal to its step, ties the classification to the recorded outcome, and names every failure and outcome the trace leaves unexplained. Trace analysis: per-job money is wever_job-cost-brief. Verdict outcome_unexplained, fatal_failures, failures_absorbed or no_failures. POST /api/trace-outcome-brief. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-operations-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-operations/.

job.description: The job the trace belongs to.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

calls.description: Tool calls in the order made.

failures.description: Failures recorded outside a tool call.

fallback_for.description: The ID of a step this one replaces when that step fails.

action.description: Such as retry, fallback to cache or manual fix.

required.description: Whether the job needs this step. Defaults to true.

status.description: How the step ended, as recorded.

name: wever_trace-outcome-brief
title: Trace outcome brief
